description_en: Queries the details of vSwitch that are available in a virtual private cloud (VPC)
description_zh: 该接口用于查询专有网络VPC下虚拟交换机的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-vswitches --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-bp1opxu1zkhn0000 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-k --dedicated-host-group-id dhg-7a90000 --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVSwitches

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the VSwitch. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 交换机所属地域的ID。可调用DescribeRegions接口获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC to which the vSwitch belongs.

> You must configure this parameter or **DedicatedHostGroupId**
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的交换机所属VPC的ID。
>本参数和**DedicatedHostGroupId**必传其一
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the zone to which the vSwitch belongs. You can call the DescribeAvailableZones operation to query zone IDs. If you specify this parameter, the query results are filtered based on the value of this parameter and only the details of the VSwitch that is deployed in the specified zone are returned
parameters.help_zh: 交换机所属可用区的ID。您可调用DescribeAvailableZones接口获取。用于过滤调用结果，仅返回目标可用区中的虚拟交换机详情
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The dedicated cluster ID. You can call the DescribeDedicatedHostGroups operation to query the dedicated cluster ID. If you specify this parameter, the details of all VSwitches in the VPC to which the dedicated cluster belongs are returned.

>  You must specify this parameter or the **VpcId** parameter
parameters.help_zh:
专属集群ID。可调用DescribeDedicatedHostGroups获取。查询该专属集群所属专有网络VPC下所有虚拟交换机的详情。
>本参数和**VpcId**必传其一
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1 to 50**. Default value: **30**
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。取值：**1~50**。默认值：**30**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
